Generation II has nine symbols hanging from a sibship line: circle 1 crossed out, open square 2 joined to crossed-out circle 3, crossed-out squares 4, 5 and 6, a solid circle 7 with a slash joined to square 6, crossed-out circle 8 and crossed-out square 9. Generation III has solid circle 1, open squares 2 and 3, solid square 4, solid square 5 (joined to open circle 6), crossed-out square 7, open square 8 joined to open circle 9, and solid circle 10 (joined to open square 11) with a bold arrow and the letter P. Generation IV shows solid circle 1, open square 2 (a slash crosses its link to circle 3) and solid circle 3, descending from III-5 and circle 6; open circle 4 and open square 5 descend from III-8 and III-9. Generation V has open circle 1 and open square 2 below IV-2 and IV-3. Text next to four symbols reads: III-5 'E+, Optic A(+), Corneal D(+)'; III-10 'E+, Optic A(+), Corneal D(+)'; IV-1 'E+, Optic A(-), Corneal D(+)'; IV-3 'E+, Optic A(-), Corneal D(+)'. Seven symbols are solid: II-7, III-1, III-4, III-5, III-10, IV-1 and IV-3.
